prompt: Analyze frequently purchased product combinations to identify common bundles in the sales data. Write a comparison on how these co-purchase patterns vary across store locations and seasonal time periods.
title: Co-Purchase Bundle Analysis
summary: Analyze frequently purchased product combinations to identify common bundles in the sales data. Compare how these co-purchase patterns differ across store locations and seasonal time periods.
executed_sql_queries:
WITH order_products AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    oi.order_id,
    oi.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    o.order_date,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS order_year
  FROM retail.order_items oi
  JOIN retail.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN retail.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
), bundle_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    a.product_id AS product_id_1,
    a.product_name AS product_name_1,
    b.product_id AS product_id_2,
    b.product_name AS product_name_2,
    a.order_year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.order_id) AS co_purchase_frequency
  FROM order_products a
  JOIN order_products b
    ON a.order_id = b.order_id
   AND a.product_id < b.product_id
  GROUP BY a.product_id, a.product_name, b.product_id, b.product_name, a.order_year
), total_orders AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_order_count
  FROM retail.orders
)
SELECT
  bp.product_id_1,
  bp.product_name_1,
  bp.product_id_2,
  bp.product_name_2,
  bp.order_year,
  bp.co_purchase_frequency,
  ROUND(bp.co_purchase_frequency::numeric / tot.total_order_count, 6) AS bundle_share_of_orders
FROM bundle_pairs bp
CROSS JOIN total_orders tot
ORDER BY bp.co_purchase_frequency DESC, bp.order_year DESC, bp.product_name_1, bp.product_name_2
LIMIT 50

SELECT store_id, store_name AS store_location FROM retail.stores WHERE store_name IN ('Zava Retail Bellevue', 'Zava Retail Everett', 'Zava Retail Kirkland', 'Zava Retail Online', 'Zava Retail Redmond', 'Zava Retail Seattle', 'Zava Retail Spokane', 'Zava Retail Tacoma') ORDER BY store_name

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, MIN(o.order_date) AS min_order_date, MAX(o.order_date) AS max_order_date, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM retail.stores s
JOIN retail.orders o ON o.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE s.store_id BETWEEN 1 AND 8
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 0
ORDER BY s.store_id;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_order_ids
FROM retail.orders
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH store_subset AS (
    SELECT store_id
    FROM retail.stores
    ORDER BY store_id
    OFFSET 4
), filtered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.store_id, o.order_date
    FROM retail.orders o
    JOIN store_subset ss ON o.store_id = ss.store_id
    WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2020-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
), pair_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        fo.store_id,
        fo.order_id,
        LEAST(a.product_id, b.product_id) AS product_id_1,
        GREATEST(a.product_id, b.product_id) AS product_id_2
    FROM filtered_orders fo
    JOIN retail.order_items a ON fo.order_id = a.order_id AND fo.store_id = a.store_id
    JOIN retail.order_items b ON fo.order_id = b.order_id AND fo.store_id = b.store_id
     AND a.product_id < b.product_id
), pair_counts AS (
    SELECT
        po.store_id,
        po.product_id_1,
        po.product_id_2,
        COUNT(DISTINCT po.order_id) AS co_purchase_frequency
    FROM pair_orders po
    GROUP BY po.store_id, po.product_id_1, po.product_id_2
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        pc.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pc.store_id ORDER BY pc.co_purchase_frequency DESC, pc.product_id_1, pc.product_id_2) AS rn
    FROM pair_counts pc
)
SELECT
    r.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    r.product_id_1,
    p1.product_name AS product_name_1,
    r.product_id_2,
    p2.product_name AS product_name_2,
    r.co_purchase_frequency
FROM ranked r
JOIN retail.stores s ON r.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN retail.products p1 ON r.product_id_1 = p1.product_id
JOIN retail.products p2 ON r.product_id_2 = p2.product_id
WHERE r.rn <= 20
ORDER BY r.store_id, r.co_purchase_frequency DESC, r.product_id_1, r.product_id_2;

WITH order_years AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS order_year
  FROM retail.orders o
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int BETWEEN 2020 AND 2026
),
order_pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    oi.order_id,
    LEAST(oi.product_id, oj.product_id) AS product_id_1,
    GREATEST(oi.product_id, oj.product_id) AS product_id_2
  FROM retail.order_items oi
  JOIN retail.order_items oj
    ON oi.order_id = oj.order_id
   AND oi.product_id < oj.product_id
),
pair_year_counts AS (
  SELECT
    op.product_id_1,
    op.product_id_2,
    oy.order_year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT op.order_id) AS co_purchase_frequency
  FROM order_pairs op
  JOIN order_years oy
    ON op.order_id = oy.order_id
  GROUP BY op.product_id_1, op.product_id_2, oy.order_year
),
annual_totals AS (
  SELECT
    order_year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders
  FROM order_years
  GROUP BY order_year
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    pyc.order_year,
    pyc.product_id_1,
    p1.product_name AS product_name_1,
    pyc.product_id_2,
    p2.product_name AS product_name_2,
    pyc.co_purchase_frequency,
    at.total_orders,
    ROUND(pyc.co_purchase_frequency::numeric / NULLIF(at.total_orders, 0), 6) AS bundle_share_of_orders,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pyc.order_year ORDER BY pyc.co_purchase_frequency DESC, pyc.product_id_1, pyc.product_id_2) AS bundle_rank
  FROM pair_year_counts pyc
  JOIN annual_totals at
    ON pyc.order_year = at.order_year
  JOIN retail.products p1
    ON pyc.product_id_1 = p1.product_id
  JOIN retail.products p2
    ON pyc.product_id_2 = p2.product_id
)
SELECT
  order_year,
  bundle_rank,
  product_name_1,
  product_name_2,
  co_purchase_frequency,
  total_orders,
  bundle_share_of_orders
FROM ranked
WHERE order_year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2026
  AND bundle_rank <= 10
ORDER BY order_year, bundle_rank, product_name_1, product_name_2;

SELECT store_id, store_name FROM retail.stores WHERE store_name IN ('Zava Retail Bellevue','Zava Retail Everett','Zava Retail Kirkland','Zava Retail Online','Zava Retail Redmond','Zava Retail Seattle','Zava Retail Spokane','Zava Retail Tacoma') ORDER BY store_name

WITH first_store_slice AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id
  FROM retail.orders
  ORDER BY store_id
  LIMIT (SELECT GREATEST(1, COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) / 2) FROM retail.orders)
), pair_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.store_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS order_year,
    a.product_id AS product_id_a,
    b.product_id AS product_id_b,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS distinct_order_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.store_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int
      ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) DESC, a.product_id, b.product_id
    ) AS rn
  FROM retail.orders o
  JOIN first_store_slice s
    ON o.store_id = s.store_id
  JOIN retail.order_items a
    ON o.order_id = a.order_id
  JOIN retail.order_items b
    ON o.order_id = b.order_id
   AND a.product_id < b.product_id
  GROUP BY
    o.store_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int,
    a.product_id,
    b.product_id
)
SELECT
  store_id,
  order_year,
  product_id_a,
  product_id_b,
  distinct_order_count
FROM pair_counts
WHERE rn <= 10
ORDER BY store_id, order_year, distinct_order_count DESC, product_id_a, product_id_b;

WITH paired AS (
  SELECT
    o.store_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS order_year,
    a.product_id AS product_id_a,
    b.product_id AS product_id_b,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS distinct_order_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.store_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int
      ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) DESC, a.product_id, b.product_id
    ) AS rn
  FROM retail.orders o
  JOIN retail.order_items a
    ON o.order_id = a.order_id
  JOIN retail.order_items b
    ON o.order_id = b.order_id
   AND a.product_id < b.product_id
  WHERE o.store_id >= 5
  GROUP BY
    o.store_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int,
    a.product_id,
    b.product_id
)
SELECT
  store_id,
  order_year,
  product_id_a,
  product_id_b,
  distinct_order_count
FROM paired
WHERE rn <= 10
ORDER BY store_id, order_year, distinct_order_count DESC, product_id_a, product_id_b;

WITH pair_freq AS (
    SELECT
        o.store_id,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS order_year,
        LEAST(a.product_id, b.product_id) AS product_id_1,
        GREATEST(a.product_id, b.product_id) AS product_id_2,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS co_purchase_frequency
    FROM retail.orders o
    JOIN retail.order_items a
      ON o.order_id = a.order_id
    JOIN retail.order_items b
      ON o.order_id = b.order_id
     AND a.product_id < b.product_id
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int IN (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026)
    GROUP BY o.store_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int, LEAST(a.product_id, b.product_id), GREATEST(a.product_id, b.product_id)
), store_map AS (
    SELECT
        store_id,
        CASE
            WHEN store_name LIKE 'Zava Retail %' THEN REPLACE(store_name, 'Zava Retail ', '')
            ELSE store_name
        END AS store_location
    FROM retail.stores
), mapped AS (
    SELECT
        sm.store_location,
        pf.order_year,
        pf.product_id_1,
        pf.product_id_2,
        pf.co_purchase_frequency
    FROM pair_freq pf
    JOIN store_map sm
      ON pf.store_id = sm.store_id
    WHERE sm.store_location IN (
        'Bellevue',
        'Everett',
        'Kirkland',
        'Online',
        'Redmond',
        'Seattle',
        'Spokane',
        'Tacoma'
    )
)
SELECT
    store_location,
    order_year,
    COUNT(*) AS distinct_pair_count,
    SUM(co_purchase_frequency) AS sum_co_purchase_frequency,
    MIN(co_purchase_frequency) AS min_co_purchase_frequency,
    MAX(co_purchase_frequency) AS max_co_purchase_frequency
FROM mapped
GROUP BY store_location, order_year
ORDER BY store_location, order_year;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS order_year,
    s.store_name,
    p.product_name
  FROM retail.orders o
  JOIN retail.stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
  JOIN retail.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN retail.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2022
), pairs AS (
  SELECT
    a.order_year,
    a.store_name,
    LEAST(a.product_name, b.product_name) AS product_name_1,
    GREATEST(a.product_name, b.product_name) AS product_name_2,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.order_id) AS co_purchase_frequency
  FROM base a
  JOIN base b
    ON a.order_id = b.order_id
   AND a.product_name < b.product_name
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_year ORDER BY co_purchase_frequency DESC, product_name_1, product_name_2) AS bundle_rank,
    SUM(co_purchase_frequency) OVER (PARTITION BY order_year) AS total_bundle_orders_year
  FROM pairs
)
SELECT
  order_year,
  store_name,
  product_name_1,
  product_name_2,
  co_purchase_frequency,
  bundle_rank,
  ROUND(co_purchase_frequency::numeric / NULLIF(total_bundle_orders_year, 0), 6) AS bundle_share_of_orders
FROM ranked
WHERE bundle_rank <= 10
ORDER BY order_year, bundle_rank, store_name, product_name_1, product_name_2;

WITH bundle_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id,
         EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS order_year,
         o.store_id,
         CASE WHEN o.store_id = 1 THEN 'Zava Retail Bellevue'
              WHEN o.store_id = 2 THEN 'Everett'
              WHEN o.store_id = 3 THEN 'Kirkland'
              WHEN o.store_id = 4 THEN 'Online'
              WHEN o.store_id = 5 THEN 'Redmond'
              WHEN o.store_id = 6 THEN 'Seattle'
              WHEN o.store_id = 7 THEN 'Spokane'
              WHEN o.store_id = 8 THEN 'Tacoma'
              ELSE 'Other' END AS store_location
  FROM retail.orders o
  JOIN retail.order_items a ON o.order_id = a.order_id
  JOIN retail.order_items b ON o.order_id = b.order_id AND a.product_id < b.product_id
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int IN (2023, 2024, 2025, 2026)
)
SELECT order_year,
       store_location,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS co_purchase_frequency,
       ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)) OVER (), 6) AS bundle_share_of_orders
FROM bundle_orders
GROUP BY order_year, store_location
ORDER BY order_year, store_location;
